GameLog includes a minimal Apple Silicon build of libimobiledevice tools and
their runtime libraries for iOS physical-device discovery and log collection.

Component versions, provenance, architecture, and checksums are recorded in
source.properties. The complete upstream license texts are included in the
Notices directory distributed with the application:

- libimobiledevice
- libimobiledevice-glue
- libplist
- libusbmuxd
- OpenSSL
- libtasn1
- libtatsu

Copyright and license terms remain those of the respective upstream projects.
